name: Illustrate a story with an AI art director and save print and web versions to Google Drive
description: Callable workflow: reads a story, finds its most emotional detail and generates a lithograph-style illustration, saved to Google Drive in a print and a web version.
shortDescription: A callable workflow that turns a story into an illustration saved in print and web folders.
keyFeatures: Callable from other workflows with a story title and text
AI art director that finds the story's most emotional detail and writes the image prompt
Image generation in one consistent lithograph style
Saves a print version and a web version to two Google Drive folders and returns both files
prerequisites: API key for the image model provider (OpenAI by default); replace REPLACE_WITH_IMAGE_MODEL
Two Google Drive folders, for print and web; replace REPLACE_WITH_PRINT_FOLDER_ID and REPLACE_WITH_WEB_FOLDER_ID
idealFor: Authors and publishers who want a consistent illustration for every story without commissioning each one.
steps: Trigger: another workflow calls this one with a story title and text.
The art director agent picks the most emotional detail and writes an image prompt.
Download the image and save a print version and a web version to Google Drive.
Return both files to the calling workflow.
